versions.changelog:
Initial release of Douyin Short Video Factory.

- Create Douyin short videos end-to-end, including AI image generation and video prompt building.
- Extract video frames and optimize Douyin hashtags automatically.
- Integrates with Douyin’s ecosystem for content sharing.
- Includes sample scripts for video parsing, tag generation, and virality scoring.
- Supports keywords: “抖音视频”, “douyin”, “短视频创作”, “short video factory”.
